description: This PHP class 'LdapConfigurationController' extends 'AbstractVueController' and manages LDAP configuration for the OrangeHRM system. It initializes a Vue component with LDAP sync settings during the pre-render phase.

classes.name: LdapConfigurationController
classes.description: Controller for configuring LDAP settings in the OrangeHRM admin plugin, presenting the LDAP configuration Vue component and setting properties based on LDAP settings.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the LDAP configuration component before rendering, setting the visibility of LDAP sync based on current LDAP settings.
